notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list West Yellowstone 4th of July, 406-646-7701, pirates only, and Katrina with president@destinationyellowstone.com. Gmail confirms Adventure Zone emailed Katrina June 5, 2026; later correspondence says Adventure Zone was fully booked for the West Yellowstone event that year. Source: handwritten call notes page 85; Adventure Zone Gmail.

followUps.label: 2027 booking follow-up
followUps.reason: 2026 could not be accepted because Adventure Zone was fully booked. Reconnect early enough to preserve availability for 2027.
